name: Seregélyes (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, white and blue in the ratio 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Seregélyes (a crowned blue shield with a white bird, within a wreath) above the name SEREGÉLYES in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Seregélyes arms with crown and wreath
